title: 25 January 1947 — Vice-President, Union Subjects and the Close of Volume II
summary: H. C. Mookherjee is elected Vice-President; the Assembly creates a Business Committee and a committee on Union subjects, debates long-adjournment procedure, and records Somnath Lahiri's privilege complaint before adjourning to April.

title: Union Centre — What Belongs at the Centre?
summary: Rajagopalachari argues that the Cabinet Mission framework requires a specialist committee to work out the scope and interconnection of Union subjects before detailed constitution framing.

title: Expertise vs Representation in Committee Design
summary: Jaipal Singh asks why tribal areas and prominent omitted constitutionalists are absent, while Harnam Singh argues that technical expertise should dominate this committee's composition.

title: Rule 21 — How May the Assembly Adjourn?
summary: Santhanam and Gopalaswami Ayyangar argue that a future date must be fixed; the President rules that House consent permits a long adjournment even if the precise date is fixed later.

title: Somnath Lahiri — Assembly Papers and Privilege
summary: The President records Lahiri's complaint that police seized Assembly-related papers from his house and says the legal question has been referred to the Constitutional Adviser.
